description: Pull request titles follow Conventional Commits (the PR title check and release-please rely on it). pnpm 11 refuses versions younger than a day, hence minimumReleaseAge; commits by the release bot (rebuilt action bundle) do not stop Renovate from updating its branches.

packageRules.description: Workflow actions: ci(deps), one grouped pull request.
Development dependencies: chore(deps), grouped unless major.
Runtime dependencies are bundled into the CLI and the action: fix(deps), so they ship in a patch release.
The docs site is not published to npm: its dependencies are chore(deps), not releases.

Non-major updates merge themselves once every required check passes; Renovate bypasses only the code owner review (.github/rulesets/main-reviews.json). Anything that ships still waits for the release pull request, which needs approval.
0.x minor versions may break: review them.

@ciatlas/core, the workflow model, is bundled into the CLI, the action and the extension: fix(deps), so a new core ships in a patch release; one pull request for every package, without the release-age wait (it is our own release, reviewed in its release pull request). Matched by dependency name: for a github: dependency, Renovate's package name is the repository, ciatlas/core.
@types/vscode must not be newer than the oldest VS Code the extension supports (engines.vscode in packages/vscode), or vsce refuses to package it: raise both together, by hand.
Pinning to a commit SHA keeps the same version: merge it right away instead of waiting out the release age, and apart from version updates.
